First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:45 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Set by who shows up; no speed is too slow. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @chattanoogabicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Beginner/Leisure Ride group ride

Beginner/Leisure Ride is a road group ride in Chattanooga, TN. It rolls every Monday at 5:45 pm from Parking lot behind the old Food Works restaurant.

An evening ride for people new to cycling or coming back after time away. Speed and distance depend on who shows up. Leaders answer questions and help with skills. Experienced riders are welcome if they stay with the group.
